children: Sergio Traversa, a director and chief executive officer, purchased a total of 200,000 shares of common stock in two open-market transactions on September 9–10, 2026 at weighted-average prices of $4.18 for the September 9 purchases (range $4.15–$4.22) and $4.10 for the September 10 purchases (range $4.03–$4.11) for a total reported purchase amount of $828,000, and after these transactions he directly owns 1,500,000 shares of common stock.

Shenouda Maged, an officer serving as chief financial officer, purchased common stock in two open-market transactions comprising an aggregate 120,200-share lot at a disclosed weighted average price of $4.20 (with individual purchases ranging $4.16–$4.20) and a 79,800-share lot at a weighted average price of $4.25 for a combined reported purchase amount of $843,990, and following the reported transactions he directly beneficially owns 1,000,000 shares of common stock.
